title: Learning Quantum Data Distribution via Chaotic Quantum Diffusion Model
summary: Generative models for quantum data pose significant challenges but hold immense potential in fields such as chemoinformatics and quantum physics. Quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic models (QuDDPMs) enable efficient learning of quantum data distributions by progressively scrambling and denoising quantum states. However, existing implementations typically rely on circuit-based random unitary dynamics, which can be costly to implement and sensitive to control imperfections, particularly on analog quantum hardware.
